_comment: The roster of every Human Battery Project agent.
THIS FILE IS THE DECLARATION. It says what each agent is, which group it
belongs to, what it may never do, and whether it is meant to be on.
IT IS NOT THE STATUS. program-docs/agents_doc.py reads the status from the
repository itself: whether .claude/agents/<name>.md exists, whether a
workflow runs it, and whether that workflow is enabled. That is on purpose,
so the summary document cannot claim an agent that was never built.
Groups: 1 the CEO Agent, 2 the engineering team, 3 operations,

agents.name: ceo-agent
agents.title: CEO Agent
agents.job: Summarises every agent, turns Micah's directions into issues, keeps the one list of what waits on him.
never: filter, soften or delay an approval request, a canon question or a legal draft

agents.name: lead-engineer
agents.title: Lead Engineer
agents.job: Plans, assigns to the six engineers, runs the three reviewers and the gate, opens the pull request, reports to Micah.

agents.name: canon-engineer
agents.title: Canon engineer
agents.job: The coach, the in-product agents, the corpus loader, evidence tiers, the Score method versions, the research agent.
never: write the thesis or anything in docs/
let a working-model claim reach marketing

agents.name: portal-engineer
agents.title: Portal engineer
agents.job: The public site and the portal screens, approved wording only, reading level held, the mark rules obeyed.

agents.name: data-engineer
agents.title: Data engineer
agents.job: Migrations, row-level security, retention, account deletion, document versions in the bucket.
never: edit a migration that has run

agents.name: payments-engineer
agents.title: Payments engineer
agents.job: Stripe checkout and webhook, tax, discounts, continuation billing, ambassador payouts.
never: edit checkout.js or stripe-webhook.js while payments are parked

agents.name: quality-engineer
agents.title: Quality engineer
agents.job: The fixture suites, the commit gate, the deploy checks, the reading-level and claim-shape audits.
never: weaken, skip or whitelist a check

agents.name: security-engineer
agents.title: Security engineer
agents.job: Read-only review of secrets, JWT verification on every function, webhook secrets, RLS, key age.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.title: Code reviewer
agents.job: Adversarial read-only review of every change before it reaches Micah.

agents.name: security-reviewer
agents.title: Security reviewer
agents.job: Read-only security review of every change before it reaches Micah.

agents.name: canon-claims-reviewer
agents.title: Canon and claims reviewer
agents.job: Read-only review of every change against the canon, the tiers, the prohibitions and the claim shapes.

agents.name: task-keeper
agents.title: Task Keeper
agents.job: The one list of what waits on Micah, and the daily approval batch.
never: approve or act on an item

agents.name: watcher
agents.title: Watcher
agents.job: Reads Pages and Worker errors, agent_runs failures, ai_calls cost, webhooks, email delivery and database health, and sends the 7 AM ops brief.
never: restart, redeploy, retry or resume anything
put member data or a secret in the brief

agents.name: sentinel
agents.title: Sentinel
agents.job: Watches the member-safety path and can pause an agent or hold a message.
never: weaken a guardrail or decide one does not apply

agents.name: gatekeeper
agents.title: Gatekeeper
agents.job: Runs every check on every change before it reaches members.
never: whitelist a phrase to turn a run green

agents.name: steward
agents.title: Steward
agents.job: IT: Cloudflare, Supabase usage and backups, the Resend domain, certificates, domains, key age and spend.
never: change a setting, DNS, a key or anyone's access
upgrade, downgrade or cancel a plan

agents.name: compliance-officer
agents.title: Compliance Officer
agents.job: Checks claims, consents, retention and privacy against what the code actually does, plus the no-supplement and no-brand rules and the Score disclaimer.
never: give legal advice or declare something compliant

agents.name: marketing-site
agents.title: Marketing Site
agents.job: Keeps thehumanbatteryproject.com current and checks links, speed, accessibility and the grade-3 reading level.
never: touch the portal, the legal pages or member data
change approved wording or add a claim

agents.name: content-producer
agents.title: Content Producer
agents.job: Makes the daily brief video, the member lesson videos and the social captions from the canon, in the house voice and score.
never: put a claim on screen that is not in the canon with its tier
use a member's data, image, name, result or words

agents.name: key-renewal-tracker
agents.title: Key and Renewal Tracker
agents.job: Tracks key, certificate, domain, Zoom and contract dates and prepares the rotation notes.
never: hold, change or print a key

agents.name: vendor-admin-assistant
agents.title: Vendor and Admin Assistant
agents.job: Drafts vendor emails and forms for labs, incorporation, Stripe setup, Zoom and insurance, and logs what is waiting.
never: put a secret, a bank detail, a tax id or member data in a draft

agents.name: dependency-updater
agents.title: Dependency Updater
agents.job: Keeps packages patched through reviewed updates, including the PDF toolchain.
never: introduce a framework or a build step

agents.name: status-update-writer
agents.title: Status and Update Writer
agents.job: Drafts updates for advisors and partners, and the weekly call agenda built from member questions.
never: promise a date, a number, a feature or an outcome
name, quote or identify a member

agents.name: key-rotation-lowrisk
agents.title: Low-risk Key Rotation
agents.switch: set meant_to_be_on true for key-rotation-lowrisk in agents/roster.json
agents.off_because: no secrets manager has been chosen
agents.job: Rotates the low-risk keys (email, error tracking, analytics) through a secrets manager.
never: touch Supabase, Anthropic, Stripe, Cloudflare or GitHub owner keys
revoke an old key before the new one is verified

agents.name: fixer
agents.title: Fixer
agents.switch: set meant_to_be_on true for fixer in agents/roster.json
agents.off_because: its check has not been designed
agents.job: Writes fixes for known problem types as pull requests.
never: touch payments, login, consent or any word a member reads
open a pull request without a test that failed before it

agents.name: support-agent
agents.title: Support Agent
agents.switch: set meant_to_be_on true for support-agent in agents/roster.json
agents.job: Drafts replies to members and the waitlist for a person to approve, and routes medical questions.
never: handle money, a refund or a dispute

agents.name: finance-agent
agents.title: Finance Agent
agents.switch: set meant_to_be_on true for finance-agent in agents/roster.json
agents.off_because: Stripe is in test mode and payments are parked
agents.job: Stripe reconciliation, sales tax by state, unit cost per member, revenue, continuation churn and ambassador payouts due.
never: move money, refund or change a price
touch live Stripe settings or keys
